note: accepted by device observation on 2026-11-08 (ord203): lock screen, charging badge, touch, brightness, interface size, audio path all working; the three payload carriers were re-recorded on 2026-11-09 for the CI run 42504049040 delivery, whose plug-in answers kAudioDeviceTransportTypeThunderbolt (CDHash 429e404c5299306ac79128c9f27764925efab8dc), and its ADT is byte-equal to the accepted boot's except /chosen random-seed; 2026-11-09: -no_slto_panic was dropped from the line on purpose, its only reader is osfmk/kern/startup.c:473 and no accepted boot printed a spinlock timeout, and it is not a CRITICAL_ARGS row; the slot it paid for now carries dby-torch=1 plus the short-named iOS switch dby-ti=1; those two are deliberately NOT in the accepted args list, because no boot has verified them yet, and they are gated as CRITICAL_ARGS from this round on so a later trim that loses one is caught (see porting.toml); 2026-11-15: three entries left this list because the line itself moved, not because a boot lost anything - sheng-pmgr=2 is now pmgr=2 (upstream 47ec6a5 dropped the prefix from every boot argument and scripts/unixnu/payload.py refuses the native-UFS-root payload unless exactly one pmgr=2 is present, so the marker had to be renamed and nothing in this tree reads either spelling), and sheng-data-reset=1 plus sheng-disable-jobs=... are deliberately not passed (see board.toml: the first is the last variable to add to a stability measurement and the second was the argument paid for the GPU rows); all three were also stale CRITICAL_ARGS rows in scripts/check-regression.py, so the gate was red for its own reasons before it could say anything about this artifact.
